summary: CSS controls how headings and paragraphs look: font, size, color, and spacing. The HTML level stays the same no matter how big you make it.
notes: line-height: 1.5 sets the line spacing to 1.5 times the font size. A number with no unit scales with the text.
font-size on h1 and h2 replaces the browser's default sizes, so you never need to pick a heading level for its looks.
margin-top: 0 on p removes the default space above each paragraph.
pitfall: Writing font-size: 32 with no unit. The browser ignores it; most lengths need a unit like px or rem.
